content: In the Prologue Melvin-Koushki says the Mafāḥiṣ's book plan is encoded in the prologue's cosmic trinity, whose Three Globes of Light correspond to the written, spoken and mental forms of the Letter (as printed on this page: Pearl-Peach-Planet, Written-Spoken-Mental), and that the work's meta-performance of authorial humility is a 'Descent between two Ascents', glorifying the Written over the Spoken and Sight over Hearing.
